name: Izumi Miri
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c87836]Tomohiro[/url]'s cousin, she serves as his homeroom teacher and the student council advisor.
With her beauty, it's no surprise she was a magazine fashion model in her student days. Even now, she attracts the attention of the male students.
She's still young, but her speech resembles that of a gal from the past.

[From the [url=https://madosoft.net/hamidashi/sub_character]official website[/url]]
